about_the_game:
Run, jump, and slide your way to victory across 4 levels featuring a variety of obstacle courses in the Demo for Synth Race.

1-12 Player Lobbies

Race with up to 12 other players. Host a public lobby to race against other players from around the world, or host a private lobby for your friends.

4 Demo Levels

Play through 4 levels.

Time Trials

Play solo in Time Trials to beat the mastery times and top the Leaderboards. Compete among your friends in the Friend Leaderboard or with players from around the world in the Global Leaderboard.

Combat

Throw attack balls with a variety of debuffs to sabotage other players or punch them off a ledge. Choose between two attack ball modes when setting up a lobby: pick Frenzy mode to automatically receive attack balls for a very chaotic experience, or pick Block mode to collect them as you move through the level.

Cosmetics

Complete Time Trials and collect tokens hidden in each level to unlock skins and hats that show off your achievements.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: 64-Bit processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 950 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
